the `step` family the two are legitimately equal and the test would pass vacuously.

checks.detail:
18 channels x 11 tokens. The streams are estimator diagnostics,
estimated motion and commands. There is NO image encoder and no independently

evaluated.

checks.check: 5.1 N (MPC preview) and H (training rollout depth) are distinct

be labelled a controller preview.
